title: cassandra angustifolia var. anomala
intro: Cassandra angustifolia var. anomala, commonly known as Anomalous Cassandra, is a plant species within the family Apiaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Cassandra angustifolia var. anomala include acting as an anti-edematous and anti-spasmodic agent, making it useful in treating conditions like arthritis and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
